storage.accounting: Repository JSON research side information only; this is not an encoded archive or a corpus partition. Seed records and experiment reports are excluded.

candidate_algorithm: flat-scan for accumulated inventory and in-page delta; balanced product trees retained for frozen controls
product_recheck: Publication re-read all hosted rows, matched each byte span and SHA-256 against enwik9, checked each exact factor/cofactor product, verified every ordered child partition by radix-256 concatenation, checked all nineteen nested frozen inventory controls through E0144 and all page snapshots, then reconstructed the cumulative factor index.
